column1: # A spectrum analyzer has no reference plane, so nothing in the stack is calibrated out. Every component is a loss you add back by hand, and this is where you write it down.
# Measure the fixed stack loss once, as S21 on the VNA, with the pad set to zero. Enter it as a POSITIVE number of dB: an S21 of -1.4 dB is a fixed stack loss of 1.4.
# The pad is separate because you will change it. Total correction is the two added, and the corrected level is the reading plus that.
